-L: Tries every username in this list file — more usernames means more login attempts
-P: Tries every password in this list file — a bigger list takes longer and is more likely to lock the account or get noticed
-t: How many login attempts to run at the same time — faster, but more likely to lock the account or get noticed
-w: Seconds to wait between attempts — waiting longer helps avoid detection, but is slower
-M: Attacks every target listed in this file, one after another, in a single run
